title: cli start-deployment-durability: the #30120 refusal tests spawn `os start` under vitest's default 5000 ms timeout and time out on a loaded shard
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (CI on PR #37558 head `bd194d3f`, run 45834106255 attempt 1, job 139959698234 `Test Core (5/10)`). The finder files the flake (seat repo:objectstack#5, thread note 14:29Z).

Grading: `area:devpath` · reach: CI only. The file is `packages/cli/test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts`, and the test that failed is "#30120 — with the image switch on, a start missing its settings refuses > only the database missing: names only OS_DATABASE_URL" (line 291). It hit "Test timed out in 5000ms"; the file took 66,864 ms on that shard, and the other 2772 cli tests passed. The run was green on its one relay re-run (attempt 2). Evidence: measured once on CI, not reproduced locally. PR #37558 touches only spec contracts, plugin-sharing and plugin-security, so this test cannot reach its diff.
Suggested-grade: p3 · a red shard on unrelated PRs, cleared by one re-run.

## What

The three tests in the `#30120 … a start missing its settings refuses` describe (lines 281–305 at `0f6a1e518f`) run `os start` through `refuse()`, which is a `spawnSync` with `timeout: 120_000` (line 276). But the `it(…)` calls pass no per-test timeout, so vitest's default 5000 ms caps a child process that is allowed two minutes. The sibling `#31600` describe passes `LEG_TIMEOUT_MS` to each `it`, and its `beforeAll` passes 15_000.

Give the three refusal tests the same explicit budget as their siblings, `LEG_TIMEOUT_MS` or one shared constant, with the reason in a comment. Do not raise the global `testTimeout`.

Re-check: `grep -n "it('none set\|it('only the database missing\|it('a switch value that is not a switch" packages/cli/test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts` shows `it(` lines whose closing `});` carries no timeout argument.

Related: #37494 (the other default-timeout flake found by area o5-D; sqlite-wasm in plugin-security).
Dedupe: searched issues for 'start-deployment-durability'. None track this timeout.
